    The global-dimension bound for the factor Auslander algebra #

    The strict right meshes resolve the simple tops of all indecomposable represented projectives. This file identifies those tops with all simple modules over the factor Auslander algebra and then propagates the resulting projective-dimension bound through finite-length modules.
